title: Densities of Binary and Ternary Aqueous Solutions of NaCl, Na2SO4, and MgSO4, of Sea Waters, and Sea Water Concentrates
authors: B. M. Fabuss, A. Korosi, A. K. M. Shamsul Huq
experimental_method: Densities from the volume of a known mass of solution: Lipkin pycnometers at 25-75 C and sealed glass dilatometer tubes (capillary stem read with a cathetometer) at 75-175 C in an oil thermostat.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature +-0.05 C; precision of parallel measurements 0.9e-4 g/cc; calibration with benzene and water better than 0.01% in density; standard deviation calculated vs measured: 2.9e-4 (NaCl), 5.3e-4 (Na2SO4), 2.9e-4 (MgSO4) binaries; 6.1e-4, 4.3e-4, 6.2e-4 for the three ternary systems.
quality_remarks: Experimental densities at 150 and 175 C were adjusted by the authors for air compression and water evaporation in the sealed tube (175 C: ~0.01% volume compression, 0.03% concentration increase). Pressure is not controlled or printed. Table IV is headed 'NaSO4' in the printed title (typo for Na2SO4). Table I title says 'NaCl Solutions' but holds NaCl, Na2SO4 and MgSO4 blocks. Calcd columns are the authors' correlation (value3), ICT columns are literature (value2). KCl densities were measured per the text but are not tabulated.
